frame_time: t = frame / 30 s (frame centre; STFT center=True, hop 1600 @ 48 kHz)

fields.rms: broadband loudness: dB mapped [floor..ceil] -> 0..1 (see normalization), instant attack, 110 ms release
fields.low: 20-150 Hz band energy (kick/bass), same dB mapping, 90 ms release
fields.mid: 150-2000 Hz band energy (vocal/guitars/keys body), same mapping
fields.onset: log-mel spectral-flux onset strength, max-pooled per frame, / p99.5, clipped 0..1 (unsmoothed)
fields.beat_phase: 0..1 position inside the current beat (0 = on the beat)
fields.bar_phase: 0..1 position inside the current 4/4 bar (0 = downbeat)
fields.beat: index into audio.json beats of the current beat (-1 before the first beat)
fields.bar: bar number (= audio.json bars[].index; 1 = first full bar, 0 = pickup / before)
